_doc: THE DEAD ON SHOW AND WAR TROPHIES (systems/gibbets.js; the street-map part world/deadDisplays.js). BODIES: those who die by your word or your hand — the executed (the scaffold's record, systems/executions.js), a rebel leader hanged, an enemy commander slain on the field (player/fieldBattle.js), a rival House's head killed in the lists — lie in your hands for bodyDays: display them (kinds: spike over the gate, gibbet at a crossroads, gallows in the square; at a seat you rule), return them to their kin, bury them, or take a TROPHY from a great one (trophies.kinds). STAGES: days since it went up (x lasts): fresh, rotting, bones; past the last it has fallen to pieces. WHILE IT STANDS, read elsewhere: crime — a burglar's or cutpurse's chance in that town x deterrence (systems/npcTheft.js reads Gibbets.deterrence; each display: 1 - (1 - kinds.*.crime) x stageWeight); revolt — a FEAR part of the peasants' grievance pressure (systems/peasantRevolts.js reads Gibbets.revoltDread: kinds.*.revolt x stageWeight, rebels x rebelMult, towns within reach hexes at neighbourShare); mood — the town's happiness falls moodPerWeek x stageWeight (floor moodFloor). AT THE RAISING: the town remembers (npcMemory kind dead_displayed), the dead man's kin (desecrated_dead: a blood memory, read by the Nemesis), his House (rival feud + memory kinDisplayed), his realm's lord (lordMemory kin_displayed: a vendetta, read by coalitions' casus belli), his faith (clergy standing - desecration.faithStanding by its stance); your dread (Traits dread x fear.dread), renown (fear.renown), the court cowed by a traitor's head (fear.courtCowedDays). TAKEN DOWN: by you (here; your own: kin mollified; another lord's: heat, the kin grateful, the faith's thanks if it holds the body sacred), by the kin at night (kinTakeDown: weekly hash roll), by the faith (faithTakeDown by stance, after its afterDays). Every desecration is logged on world.gibbets.grievances (Gibbets.grievances: the hook a blood-feud system reads). AI REALMS (ai.*): the realms' own executed go up at their capitals (highborn and traitors likelier). TROPHIES are heirlooms (data/heirlooms.json kinds skull_cup, trophy_banner, trophy_sword: their bonus and Prestige a year read by the heirloom machinery) carrying item.trophy: dread in that realm (Atrocities.termsShift reads Gibbets.trophyDread: siege terms), its lord's vendetta (trophy_held, renewed yearly), the faith's disapproval (a skull cup: faithStanding, yearly), demands for its return (demandEveryDays: the realm offers its treasury's price; return it for that, or as a peace term when at war), and the realm may steal it back (stealChance a year).

spike.label: Head on a spike over the gate
spike.desc: Set the head on a pike above the gate, where every carter and pilgrim passes under it.

gibbet.label: Gibbet cage at the crossroads
gibbet.desc: Hang the body in an iron cage at the crossroads outside town, for the crows and the travellers.

gallows.label: Left hanging on the gallows
gallows.where: on the gallows in the square
gallows.desc: Leave the body on the gallows in the square, where the market is held.

skull_cup.label: Skull cup
skull_cup.desc: Have his skull rimmed in silver and drink from it at your table.

trophy_banner.label: Captured banner
trophy_banner.desc: Hang his banner upside down in your hall.

trophy_sword.label: His sword
trophy_sword.desc: Take up his sword, and wear it where his kin can see it.

raised: By your order {name}'s {what} goes up {where} in {town}. People cross the street rather than look.
kinTook: In the night someone cut down {name}'s {what} in {town}. Fresh earth was found in the churchyard by morning.
{name}'s kin came for the body in the dark. The {what} in {town} stands empty.
faithTook: The priests of {town} took {name} down from the {what} and buried {him} in hallowed ground. They say the dead belong to God, not to {lord}.
The clergy of {town} would not suffer {name} to hang longer: the body is down and buried.
fell: What was left of {name} has fallen from the {what} in {town}.
demand: Envoys of {realm} come to your hall: they want {item} back, and will pay {price} gold out of their treasury for it.
